items.information: # **PLEASE READ THE MUSEUM ADMISSION TAB** We're excited to welcome competitors back to Denver for another fun day of speedcubing! Please make sure to read all tabs before registering. These tabs include important information regarding your responsibilities as a competitor and are very important! * **This competition has a 105 competitor limit.** * Please Only Bring Two Guests * Competitions fill quickly, so it is recommended you register as soon as possible to save a spot. * Be sure to familiarize yourself with the WCA regulations. If this is your first official competition,[ this video ](https://m.youtube.com/watch?v=dPL3eV-A0ww)will provide you with most of the information you need. * If this is your first competition, please be present for the competitor tutorial at 8:15 AM. * **If you are unable to make the competition, please withdraw your registration as soon as possible by emailing the organizing team**, to ensure competitors on the waitlist can compete.
